metadata.question: Was there more rainfall near Villarrica during January 1 and December 31, 2021 as compared to 5 years prior?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Villarrica (coordinates: -39.28, -72.23 in Chile) - Time periods: * 2021: January 1 - December 31, 2021 * 5 years prior (2016): January 1 - December 31, 2016 - Collection: CHIRPS daily precipitation data (most reliable for rainfall) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed (CHIRPS is a precipitation product, not optical imagery) - Simply sum total precipitation for each year 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero: If precipitation sum is 0 or very low but calculation succeeds - C1: If no images found in collection - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels (unlikely with CHIRPS global coverage) - C3: If result is None/NaN - A: If 2021 rainfall > 2016 rainfall - B: If 2021 rainfall <= 2016 rainfall ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location (Villarrica, Chile) const villarrica = ee.Geometry.Point([-72.23, -39.28]); // 2. Define time periods const date2021Start = '2021-01-01'; const date2021End = '2021-12-31'; const date2016Start = '2016-01-01'; const date2016End = '2016-12-31'; // 3. Load CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // 4. Filter for 2021 const precip2021 = chirps.filterDate(date2021Start, date2021End) .filterBounds(villarrica); const count2021 = precip2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images: ${count2021}`); if (count2021 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2021.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Filter for 2016 const precip2016 = chirps.filterDate(date2016Start, date2016End) .filterBounds(villarrica); const count2016 = precip2016.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2016 Images: ${count2016}`); if (count2016 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2016.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Calculate total rainfall for each year const total2021 = precip2021.select('precipitation').sum(); const total2016 = precip2016.select('precipitation').sum(); // 7. Reduce to get values at Villarrica const rainfall2021 = total2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const rainfall2016 = total2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: villarrica, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); // 8. Check for valid results if (rainfall2021 === null || rainfall2016 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null result'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (isNaN(rainfall2021) || isNaN(rainfall2016)) { console.log('Calculation failed - NaN result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Print results console.log(`2021 Total Rainfall: ${rainfall2021.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`2016 Total Rainfall: ${rainfall2016.toFixed(2)} mm`); console.log(`Difference: ${(rainfall2021 - rainfall2016).toFixed(2)} mm`); // 10. Determine answer if (rainfall2021 > rainfall2016) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
